name: caption-teleprompter
title: Caption Teleprompter
description: The whole transcript scrolls smoothly through a short window with the current line centred, past lines fading above and the next line waiting below.
useWhen: The speech is long and continuous, such as an explainer, a talk or a narrated walkthrough, and the viewer benefits from seeing the line before and the line after.
You want calm, reading-first captions that never cut or pop, only glide from one line to the next.
avoidWhen: You want one phrase at a time that replaces the last: use caption-subtitle or caption-slot.
The captions should feel energetic and social: use caption-karaoke or caption-highlight-box.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Captions
variables.description: Word timings as JSON: [{"text","startMs","endMs"}] in milliseconds, or [{"text","start","end"}] in seconds. A transcript from Mosio works as is.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Caption text size in pixels (at 1080 px on the short side).

variables.label: Page window
variables.description: Words that start within this window share one page of captions. A sentence end always starts a new page.

variables.label: Hold
variables.description: How long the last page stays after its final word.

variables.label: Shadow
variables.description: Soft shadow behind the text for legibility on footage.

variables.label: Visible lines
variables.description: How many lines fit in the window.

variables.label: Future opacity
variables.description: Opacity of lines not yet reached.

variables.label: Upcoming opacity
variables.description: Opacity of upcoming words inside the current line.
